summary: Ukrainian long-range drones struck the OZON warehouse in Chapayevsk, Samara Oblast, and the Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery, while another attack hit the OZON logistics complex in Orenburg. Russian ballistic missiles struck a Kyiv railway enterprise and the Boryspil district, killing one and injuring five, alongside widespread strikes on Kiev, Chernigov, Nikolaev, Zaporozhye, and Sumy. Russian forces liberated Zelenye village in Zaporizhzhia region after a breakthrough by the 36th Separate Motorized Infantry Brigade, pressured Kupyansk, and conducted active operations in Sumy and Kharkiv regions.
key_points: Ukrainian drones destroyed the OZON warehouse in Chapayevsk and hit the Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery in Samara Oblast. (Source: @UkraineNow/83617)
Ukrainian drones struck the OZON logistics complex in Orenburg causing a major fire. (Source: @eRadarrua/106798)
Russian ballistic missile strike on Boryspil district killed one, injured five, and damaged infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/83616)
Russian forces liberated Zelenye village in Zaporizhzhia region after a breakthrough by the 36th Brigade. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian "North" group conducting active fighting near Pysarivka and Ulianovo in Sumy region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian troops control Central and Jubilee districts of Kupyansk with fighting ongoing. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
France pledged interceptor missiles for Ukrainian air defense and licenses for missile production. (Source: @UkraineNow/83621)
Fire at former Iskra plant in Lviv killed three; a conscription center employee was stabbed in Lviv. (Source: @UkraineNow/83624, @ukr_leaks_eng/32654)

points: Ukrainian long-range drones conducted deep strikes inside Russia, hitting the OZON warehouse in Chapayevsk, Samara Oblast, and the Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery, with subsequent confirmation of a strike on the OZON logistics complex in Orenburg causing a major fire. (Source: @UkraineNow/83617, @eRadarrua/106798, @tass_agency/391601)

A fire at the former Iskra plant in Lviv killed three people; the facility reportedly stored aerosol cans. Separately, a 25-year-old man stabbed a 55-year-old conscription center employee during a document check in Lviv. (Source: @UkraineNow/83624, @ukr_leaks_eng/32654)

Ukrainian Air Force Captain Onistrat warned that heating and hot water may be cut as early as November, with electricity available only a few hours per day, mostly at night. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32667)

France announced delivery of a batch of interceptor missiles for Ukrainian air defense systems and confirmed readiness to provide licenses for missile production, following a two-hour call between Macron and Zelenskyy. (Source: @UkraineNow/83621)

Ukrainian air defense tracked multiple jet UAVs (Shahed-type) across eastern, northern, and southern regions, including Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Mykolaiv, Odesa, and Kirovohrad oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/74103, @kpszsu/74085, @kpszsu/74086, @kpszsu/74118, @kpszsu/74089, @kpszsu/74092, @kpszsu/74102, @kpszsu/74119, @eRadarrua/106804)

Russian forces launched a massive nighttime ballistic missile barrage targeting Kiev, Chernigov, Nikolaev, Zaporozhye, and Sumy, followed by a daytime strike on a shopping center in Krivoy Rog. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

A ballistic missile struck a railway enterprise in Kyiv, killing one worker; another hit Boryspil district, killing one civilian and injuring five, damaging a warehouse, parking lot, vehicles, and a gas station. (Source: @UkraineNow/83612, @UkraineNow/83616)

Russian troops advanced in the Zaporizhzhia direction: the 36th Separate Motorized Infantry Brigade of the 29th Army ("East" group) broke through defenses north of Rybal's'ke and west of Blahodatne, liberating the village of Zelenye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

In the Kharkiv region, the Russian "North" group pushed back Ukrainian forces on the Volchansk section, repelling a counterattack by the 23rd Separate Mechanized Infantry Battalion; fighting continues in Dolzhanka on the Velikoburluk section. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Russian forces control the Central and Jubilee districts of Kupyansk with ongoing fighting for the city; in the LPR, one civilian killed and eight injured (including a minor) in Severodonetsk, Svatove district, and Lysychansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Belgorod region suffered two civilian deaths and at least 10 injuries over 24 hours from drone attacks across multiple districts; Kursk region saw a Ukrainian drone strike a garage in Rzhava village, injuring a man. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Russian officials claimed strikes on Donbas and Novorossiya are directly linked to Western military aid deliveries, and accused Kiev of targeting civilian objects for political pressure. (Source: @tass_agency/391595, @tass_agency/391599)

Russian 36th Separate Motorized Infantry Brigade (29th Army, "East" group) broke through Ukrainian defenses north of Rybal's'ke and west of Blahodatne in Zaporizhzhia region, liberating the village of Zelenye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
South of Druzhkivka, Russian forces are fighting in the area of the liberated settlement of Nikolopol in the DPR. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
In the DPR, one civilian (including a teenager) was killed and 13 injured yesterday due to Ukrainian strikes on roads, minibuses, and trucks. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

In the LPR, one civilian killed and eight injured (including a minor) in Severodonetsk, Svatove district, and Lysychansk; infrastructure damaged in Stakhanov, Rubizhne, and Rovenky. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian troops hold the Central and Jubilee districts of Kupyansk with continued fighting for full control of the city. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Eastern Zaporizhzhia region saw two civilians killed and five injured from Ukrainian strikes over the past day. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian "North" group of forces conducting the most active fighting near Pysarivka and Ulianovo in the Sumy region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
In the Kursk region, a Ukrainian drone attacked a garage attached to a private house in Rzhava village, injuring one man. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Belgorod region: two civilians killed (one in Nikolskoye from drone detonation, one near Razumnoe from FPV strike on a car) and at least 10 injured across Belgorod, Valuisky, Volokonovsky, Graivoronsky, Ivnyansky, Krasnoyaruzhsky, Rakityansky, and Shebekinsky districts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Jet UAVs detected in northern Chernihiv region heading toward the regional center; another jet UAV from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region (Brovary district) per ballistic missile alert. (Source: @kpszsu/74086, @mon1tor_ua/70943)
Jet UAV from Chernihiv region to Poltava region (Lubensky district) reported by monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70950)
Jet UAV in eastern Kharkiv region moving northwest; on the Volchansk section Russian "North" group repelled a Ukrainian battalion counterattack. (Source: @kpszsu/74085, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Russian forces launched nighttime strikes targeting port facilities in Odesa; ballistic missile hit the Rozdilna railway station in Odesa region, damaging the station building. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32656, @UkraineNow/83612)

Multiple jet UAVs launched from the Black Sea toward Mykolaiv region; additional jet UAVs from southern Mykolaiv region toward Odesa region, including at Chornomorske and Buyalyk. (Source: @kpszsu/74064, @kpszsu/74089, @kpszsu/74092, @kpszsu/74102, @kpszsu/74065)

In the Kherson region, constant mutual strikes across the Dnipro River; Russian sources estimate eight civilians killed and 30 injured (including one child) on the Russian-held side over the past week. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Zaporizhzhia region air defense tracked a jet UAV in the south moving westward and an "Italmas" type UAV past Novomykolaivka toward Slavhorod. (Source: @eRadarrua/106796)

Dnipropetrovsk region: strike UAV group and jet UAV group detected; jet UAV headed toward Myrolyubivka and another toward Kryvyi Rih from the northwest. (Source: @eRadarrua/106736, @eRadarrua/106804, @kpszsu/74111)
Kirovohrad region: jet UAV detected heading toward Kropyvnytskyi from the north. (Source: @kpszsu/74119, @eRadarrua/106804)

Massive Ukrainian long-range drone campaign struck strategic targets deep inside Russia: OZON warehouse in Chapayevsk (Samara), Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery (Samara), OZON logistics complex in Orenburg, and reportedly an oil refinery in Perm. (Source: @UkraineNow/83617, @eRadarrua/106798, @tass_agency/391601, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Russian ballistic missile strikes hit Kyiv (railway enterprise), Boryspil district (warehouse, parking, gas station), and widespread targets across Kiev, Chernigov, Nikolaev, Zaporozhye, and Sumy overnight. (Source: @UkraineNow/83612, @UkraineNow/83616, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Intense jet UAV (Shahed) activity across Ukraine: multiple waves from Black Sea, Chernihiv, and southern directions targeting Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Kirovohrad, and Zaporizhzhia regions. (Source: @kpszsu/74064, @kpszsu/74085, @kpszsu/74086, @kpszsu/74118, @kpszsu/74089, @kpszsu/74092, @kpszsu/74102, @kpszsu/74119, @kpszsu/74103, @kpszsu/74111, @mon1tor_ua/70950, @eRadarrua/106804)
Ballistic missile threats reported from northeastern direction; all-clear issued after alerts in Kyiv and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/106748, @mon1tor_ua/70944, @mon1tor_ua/70943)

France committed to supplying interceptor missiles for Ukrainian air defense systems and providing licenses for domestic missile production to counter escalating Russian air attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/83621)

Ukrainian air defense units actively tracking and engaging incoming UAV groups and ballistic missiles across multiple oblasts simultaneously. (Source: @kpszsu/74064, @kpszsu/74085, @kpszsu/74086, @kpszsu/74118, @kpszsu/74089, @kpszsu/74092, @kpszsu/74102, @kpszsu/74119, @kpszsu/74103, @kpszsu/74111, @mon1tor_ua/70950, @eRadarrua/106804)
Russian sources acknowledge Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian territory, with TASS confirming UAV debris caused fire at Orenburg OZON complex. (Source: @tass_agency/391601)

sections.threat_assessment: Ukrainian long-range drone strikes have expanded to target major Russian logistics hubs (OZON warehouses in Chapayevsk and Orenburg) and energy infrastructure (Novokuybyshevsk refinery, possibly Perm), signaling a sustained campaign to degrade Russian rear-area sustainment. Russian ballistic missile barrages against Kyiv and multiple regional centers indicate continued emphasis on striking Ukrainian command, control, and transportation nodes. On the ground, Russian forces are making incremental gains in Zaporizhzhia (Zelenye) and maintaining pressure on Kupyansk, while the "North" group conducts active operations in Sumy and Kharkiv. The simultaneous intensification of deep strikes and front-line offensives suggests a coordinated Russian effort to stretch Ukrainian air defenses and exploit perceived vulnerabilities ahead of winter.
sections.regional_response: France has responded to escalating Russian air attacks by committing interceptor missiles for Ukrainian air defense systems and offering licenses for domestic missile production, a significant step toward reducing Ukraine's dependence on foreign supply chains for critical air defense munitions. Russian officials, via TASS, frame Western military aid as the direct driver of strikes on Donbas and Novorossiya, while accusing Ukraine of targeting civilians for political pressure — narratives likely intended to justify continued escalation domestically. The cross-border drone campaign into Samara and Orenburg oblasts may prompt Russian authorities to reinforce air defense coverage over strategic industrial zones, potentially diverting assets from front-line areas.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of Ukrainian UAV strikes — targeting OZON facilities in Chapayevsk and Orenburg, plus oil refineries — suggests a deliberate strategy to disrupt Russian e-commerce logistics and fuel production simultaneously. The use of jet UAVs (Shahed-type) in large numbers across multiple Ukrainian oblasts indicates Russia maintains high-volume loitering munition production despite sanctions. The reported liberation of Zelenye by the 36th Brigade (29th Army) confirms Russian offensive capacity in southern Zaporizhzhia, while the failure of the Ukrainian 23rd Mechanized Battalion counterattack at Volchansk highlights Russian defensive resilience in Kharkiv. The stabbing of a conscription officer in Lviv and Captain Onistrat's dire utility warnings point to growing domestic strain in western Ukraine.
